findings.failure_scenario: A maintainer or user reading the DYNAMIC_ENUM strategy's Javadoc is told 'If {@code o} implements ReadMarshallable...' but the method signature has no parameter named o (it is now target), so the doc misleads anyone trying to understand or extend the deserialization path; javadoc regeneration also carries this dangling reference into the published API docs
findings.summary: DYNAMIC_ENUM.readUsing Javadoc still references parameter '{@code o}', which was renamed to 'target', leaving the published API doc pointing at a nonexistent parameter

findings.failure_scenario: The DEMARSHALLABLE strategy's Javadoc states 'If {@code using} is a DemarshallableWrapper...' but the renamed method no longer has a 'using' parameter (now 'target'); the stale name misdescribes the dispatch logic for the published API documentation and any reader cross-referencing the signature
findings.summary: DEMARSHALLABLE.readUsing Javadoc still references parameter '{@code using}', which was renamed to 'target', leaving a stale reference to a renamed parameter
